headline_findings.finding: Every HQ210 escape route is closed: UNBOUNDED string leaf, UNBOUNDED exact-ref kind, numeric magnitude on a string leaf, generic authoring of both empty families, and the ten actor/person-semantic role witnesses all refuse.

Every commissioned bypass route is closed, including hand-authored schema mappings, hand-built bindings, hand-built governed rules, direct registry builds, deep nesting and array items. The gate runs on the node mapping and at all five entry points.
Semantic UNBOUNDED is closed while lawful structural-cardinality UNBOUNDED survives, and an UNBOUNDED semantic leaf nested inside an UNBOUNDED array is refused. No over-closing.
The valid-empty ceiling for V556_INTERACTION_RELATION and V556_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISITE is now machinery, enforced independently at authoring and at registry build.
The participant-role ceiling is a genuine positive allowlist: 0 of 10 prior witnesses and 0 of 12 novel labels accepted, including CIVIC_ASSOCIATION which a blacklist would have admitted.
M3 and M2 are byte-identical (9a4b26b2, deef8a60), contain zero substrate references, and the change is a pure leaf with zero production importers.

111/111 reproduces; the 15-failure discriminating set against the unrepaired module reproduces; the old 92/92 baseline reproduces. The candidate's own non-discriminating-witness disclosure is independently confirmed.

The class/family coherence check exists only in author_governed_rule, not in V556RuleMaterialRegistry.build. Two consistently-rehashed hand-built rules with other admitted classes registered successfully. Dormant in this tranche because all admitted classes map to the single authorable family.
test_schema_class_must_be_the_class_authorized_by_its_family asserts a map entry equals itself and never attempts a mismatch, while its docstring claims a mismatch is refused.
test_w10_court_does_not_prove_itself_from_production_vocabulary assembles its own banned identifiers by string concatenation, so its AST scan cannot find them and the assertion cannot fail.
test_payload_participant_helper_is_declared_a_court_helper_not_seam_enforcement asserts docstring substrings; the factual half of the same test is genuine and holds.
Environment and baseline are honestly classified as reconstructed/structural, not governed; the structural substitute's four legs were independently verified.
